- Status is communicated through glyph position and text, never color alone

For the per-element specifications, I'm looking at the brand treatment as a typographic system in the sticky header — a monospace badge or chip containing a short code identifier, paired horizontally with an uppercase display wordmark and a subdued mono sub-label, all baseline-aligned.
